title: Ancestor rediscovers the seven lost Spanish gold mines of New Mexico

tellings.quote: goes looking in New Mexico for the uh the seven lost Spanish gold mines of of southern New Mexico and within a year he discovered them and he opened up these 450 year old gold mines

plain: An ancestor of the researcher Luke Caverns is said to have gone looking for the seven lost Spanish gold mines of southern New Mexico and found them within a year. Caverns tells Michels this as family history he was told, saying the man "opened up these 450 year old gold mines." If true, mines the Spanish worked and then lost would have been found again in the American Southwest.
